breve: Playback class used for resampled AudioStreams.
descricao: Playback class used to mix an AudioStream's audio samples to 'AudioServer.get_mix_rate' using cubic interpolation.

metodos.desc: Returns an AudioStream's sample rate, in Hz. Used to perform resampling.

metodos.assinatura: _mix_resampled(dst_buffer: AudioFrame*, frame_count: int) -> int virtual required
metodos.desc: Called by 'begin_resample' to mix an AudioStream to 'AudioServer.get_mix_rate'. Uses '_get_stream_sampling_rate' as the source sample rate. Returns the number of mixed frames.
Called when an AudioStream is played. Clears the cubic interpolation history and starts mixing by calling '_mix_resampled'.
